E2-2026-T3-P1-S5.trunk: This is why the delays have thrown the industry into chaos（这就是这些延误使铁路业陷入混乱的原因）
structure: 主句：This is why the recent severe delays ... have thrown the rail industry into chaos
├ 过去分词短语〔修饰 delays〕：caused by numerous maintenance works
├ 时间状语从句(when)：at a time when most people head on holiday
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which matters for business in a country
└ 定语从句(where)：where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP
E2-2026-T3-P1-S5.logic: why从句承接上文铁路受欢迎的背景；两个从句继续说明延误恰逢度假期，并在旅游业占比高的国家具有商业影响。
notes: throw ... into chaos 意为“使……陷入混乱”。
head on holiday 指启程度假。
account for 意为“占据某一比例”。

E2-2026-T3-P1-S7.trunk: Ferrovie said 23 percent of trains were late（意大利国家铁路公司称23%的列车晚点）
structure: 主句：Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane said
│   └ 定语从句(that)：that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI
└ 宾语从句〔省略that〕：23 percent of all high-speed trains ... were late in 2023
└ 定语从句〔省略that，修饰 trains〕：it operated
E2-2026-T3-P1-S7.logic: 两个嵌套的定语从句分别交代集团资产和晚点列车范围，去掉后主干只是“公司称23%的高铁晚点”。
notes: publicly controlled 指由公共部门控股或控制。
train operator 与 train network 分别是列车运营商和铁路网运营主体。

E2-2026-T3-P1-S18.trunk: It will allow for a reduction of the distance（它将使列车间隔缩短）
structure: 主句：It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains
└ 现在分词短语〔修饰 trains〕：travelling on the same line at any given time
非限制性定语从句(which)：which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity
E2-2026-T3-P1-S18.logic: 主句说明技术可缩短同线列车间隔，which概括这一整件事并推出运力和流畅度提高的结果。
notes: allow for 在此意为“使……成为可能”。
distance 实际指安全运行间隔。
traffic fluidity 指交通或列车运行的流畅程度。
